notes.title: Bug Fix July 29th
notes.notes:
Changelog

- Fixed a bug where a missplaced trigger during the basement section caused the player to be sent to the wrong scene
- Made small changes to the script for narrative consistency

notes.title: Bug Fix - July 8th
notes.notes:
Changelog

- Fixed a bug where the character dialogue during the "House Entrance" section wouldn't be interactable if chosen to "stay" after a certain loop.

notes.title: Patch - July 7th
notes.notes:
Changelog

- Fixed a bug where examining a certain part of the scenario during the "House Entrance" investigation on the second chapter would put you back at the wrong scene.

- Major typo/Grammer fixes
- Several tweaks to the game's dialogue.

As always, in case of any bugs, comments or suggestions, feel free to contact me through e-mail (biomacchia.art@gmail.com) or twitter (https://twitter.com/Biomacchia_art)

notes.title: Patch - June 26th
notes.notes:
- Added a SFW/NSFW toggle option in the game menu.

This option will allow the player to choose between SFW and NSFW versions of the illustrations.
Note that the switch can be made at any time, but for a better experience, it is recommended that each "loop" be played on one version or the other.

notes.title: Bug Fix 25/06
notes.notes: - Fixed a bug where the game would show an error message upon choosing to "stay" after a loop during the second chapter.
